result: The heavy-ball method adds the previous step to the gradient step, x_{t+1} = x_t − α∇f(x_t) + β(x_t − x_{t−1}). On a quadratic with condition number κ, the optimal α, β contract the error by (√κ − 1)/(√κ + 1) per step instead of (κ − 1)/(κ + 1): about √κ times fewer iterations.
result_plain: Heavy-ball momentum: error shrinks by (√κ − 1)/(√κ + 1) per step on quadratics, vs (κ − 1)/(κ + 1) for GD.
